Spine runs benefits, people ops, and compliance for startups for free.

It gives companies dedicated senior HR and benefits specialists who work directly with their teams in Slack, on top of the systems they already use like Rippling, Deel, Gusto, and ADP.

HR software makes many workflows easier, but someone still has to run open enrollment, deal with carriers, answer employee questions, resolve payroll issues, handle compliance, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. At startups, that work often falls on founders, finance, or ops teams, taking time away from building the company.

Spine takes that work off their plate. It runs benefits administration, people ops, multi-state hiring, compliance, onboarding/offboarding, payroll, and employee support. It also helps companies find better-fit health plans and has reduced healthcare costs by around 15% on average.

Spine is free for startups because it becomes their benefits broker and is paid by insurance carriers.

Founders Onur Kardeşler and Ece Cokar previously built companies together with $1B+ in combined value and started Spine to build the service they wished they’d had themselves.
Start here: https://lnkd.in/gkQTFr42, or, reach out at onur@joinspine.ai

Congrats on the launch, Onur and Ece!
